release_scope: New route, scoped CSS, rendered-HTML and mobile/PWA tests only. No existing production routes, dependencies, schema, hosting bindings or service-worker changes.

verification.migrations: Forward compatibility, fresh migrations and populated upgrade paths passed.
verification.release_browser_tests: 7 of 7 passed, including member/admin journeys and robotics-data responsive and offline coverage.
verification.live_http: HTTP 200 for /, /robotics-data and /apply on both mewtuals.com and www.mewtuals.com.
verification.domains: Both custom domains report active routing and active SSL.
verification.discoverability: Live robotics route renders noindex,nofollow. Both homepages have no link to the route. Unlisted, not authenticated.
verification.contact: Pilot section asks recipients to reply to the person who shared the page; no unverified mailbox or prototype form used.

local_verification_limits: The broader development checkout browser suite did not pass against its pre-existing app database, which has historical migration-journal drift. A documented migration attempt rolled back without changing that database.
Final browser verification used the exact scoped release checkout with its own ignored local configuration and a fresh disposable PostgreSQL database. Its complete seven-test suite passed.
Database/service/schema code is identical between the scoped release base and the checkout used for the database and acceptance gates.
